files.description: Consult when a change touches any file: defines the agent caveat for this Next.js release and the portfolio rules that apply inside this repository.
Consult when a change touches the contact form or a page that renders it: defines the submission schema, honeypot, Turnstile verification, recipient routing and inquiry email rendering.
Consult when a change touches the contact server action: defines the field names, hidden honeypot, source input and Turnstile widget that the action depends on.
Consult when a change touches Sanity schemas or the Studio route: defines the Studio base path and the fixed document ids that make the three singletons.
Consult when a change touches CMS content on a page or a schema field: defines the GROQ projections the home page, pre-construction page and footer read.
Consult when a change touches the Turnstile widget, the Studio or third-party scripts: defines the site-wide security headers and records why Content-Security-Policy is off.
